name: Ano Sora no Mukougawa
source:
Main character starts to date his classmate Miho with the mediation of childhood friend Sayaka. Miho often looks at the sky and prays to it as if in ritual. After the first real date Miho disappears, and another girl Misa with the same surname takes her place. Misa claims that Miho died in a traffic accident while they were children. In this world only protagonist, Sayaka and friend Yuki remember grown-up Miho. Is it possible to return to the original world with Miho alive?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在青梅竹马沙耶香的撮合下，主人公开始与同班同学美穗交往。美穗经常仰望天空，仿佛举行仪式般向它祈祷。第一次正式约会后，美穗消失了，取代她的是另一名与她同姓的女孩美沙。美沙声称，美穗早在儿时便死于交通事故。在这个世界里，只有主人公、沙耶香和朋友由纪还记得长大后的美穗。他们有可能回到那个美穗仍然活着的原本世界吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
